title: gaussian_splatting: HLOD S1a: .gsplatworld v2 node table and the world-aligned octree bake (Refs #1131)
abstract:
Refs #1131, #1056

## Scope and Review Anchor

HLOD S1a: format v2 and bake core, implementing accepted ADR `docs/architecture/adr-hlod-streaming.md` sections 6.1-6.3, 7 and tests 3-4. Risk R3 (persistence, format and importer). Immutable base `64cb1fee056c195ab9ba5c8347245e766deec8c4`; original branch base `f98243887a7`; current head `8a452150d47` (round 8 `8a452150d47`: fallible HLOD interior-merge allocations, see below; round 7 `23b22da93e2`: fallible HLOD bake allocations, see below; round 6 `98a2c85fed9`: editor reimport now reloads the complete world state via a `GaussianSplatWorld::copy_from()` override, with a both-direction reload-equality test that is revert-proven by 28 assertions failing; round 5 `0103adeeb43` on top of round 4 `fd93368e59c`, master merged at `8bbcb1f2e92`). Human maintainer R3 approval remains required. This is not S1b representation selection, S2a runtime cuts or alpha acceptance.

## Implementation

- World-aligned lattice octree, origin-centred root for origin-plane crossings, grouped/index-split leaves, no node over 16,384 splats. Importance-ordered leaf payload; breadth-first interior payload.
- `sat` moment matching, bounded inflation, node-relative positions, single-child bit identity and DC-encoding-aware merge cells. Explicit all-pass-through exit preserves payload and SH unchanged.
- World format v2: HLOD flag, 80-byte header extension, 128-byte node/instance records and bounded non-overlapping sections. Disjoint noncanonical ordering is allowed; v1 reading and tree-less saving remain intact. World importer version is 4 (3 for the v1 -> v2 bake, 4 for the header-bounds rule); PLY/SPZ importer versions are unchanged. The header world AABB must enclose the root node's world AABB.
- Public `bake_hlod()`, `has_hlod_tree()`, `get_hlod_info()`. No implicit export bake. Failed bakes preserve state; successful publication installs payload, chunks, tree and revision before notifications. Snapshot saving captures payload/SH/2D metadata/revision under one read lock and rejects stale pre-capture edits before writing.
- Active file-backed source replacement invalidates its old tree and leaf chunk addresses. Bake captures the full resident count/payload/SH/2D/revision under the existing data lock, retains the original strongly, and revalidates revision plus publishes under that same lock before notifications. Intervening GaussianData edits are retained and reject the bake, not overwritten. World setters retain their existing main-thread ownership assumption; this is not arbitrary concurrent World-setter safety.
- Normal source loading follows actual Godot import metadata through the module-owned import-aware loader. Raw direct loader calls stay raw for importer prevalidation. Source v1 reimport produces a v2 copy without changing source bytes; invalid v2 cannot overwrite an earlier successful import. Recovery keeps the documented plain-copy fallback, not a silent changed rendering interpretation.
- QA preparation performs bounded editor import and native ConfigFile sidecar/artifact verification before selected scenes. Nonzero exit, malformed/invalid metadata, absent required sidecars/remap/destinations, non-string entries and no verified imports fail closed. Keep/skip and ignored-directory semantics remain supported. No baseline, capture requirement or threshold was relaxed.
- Reject node spheres below any stored half-axis extent and parent spheres that cannot enclose child spheres. Bake uses the same rounded bounds and upward radius rounding. Valid isotropic Gaussian spheres smaller than the AABB diagonal remain valid. The current resident leaf-chunk adapter bounds precise/runtime AABB corners about its emitted float centre and pads the serialized sphere for centre displacement, rounding the runtime radius upward. This prevents false resident culls even at the tested 1e6 offset.
- Remove ten PR-owned redundant virtual declarations on override methods without changing dispatch.

The ADR records the origin-root local-edit caveat (root growth may re-address direct leaf children, depth >= 2 remains stable), preserves the 2D flag without inventing new rendering semantics, and rejects unimplemented proxy payloads. Today's renderer still consumes absolute float32 leaf positions; no runtime consumer reads interior representations yet. Changed chunk partition/order can change image bits: this is not an unchanged-rendering guarantee. Subsequent DC-encoding work must use the next format/importer versions.

## Review Round 4: Live Bounds and Leaf Chunks (Codex P1 + P2 on 3af5914)

Both findings were valid. Fixed in `fd93368e59c`:
- **P1 `PRRT_kwDORquMSc6rAGeH`:** `set_gaussian_data()` on a world with an HLOD tree dropped the tree but kept its leaf chunks, which index the old payload. `_assign_gaussian_data()` now clears `static_chunks` with a non-empty tree, matching the file-backed `set_chunk_payload_source()` route. Tree-less worlds keep the chunks their producer set.
- **P2 `PRRT_kwDORquMSc6rAGeK`:** `bake_hlod()` kept the pre-bake bounds on the live world. It now publishes the world's bounds united with the root, rounded outward: the same bounds the saver writes, through the shared `gs_hlod_bounds_enclosing_root()`. The saved header equals the live baked bounds in all three modes, so importer output is unchanged and its version stays 4.
- **Linux build on `3af5914`:** GCC parsed the frustum test's `AABB root(Vector3(real_t(lo[0]), ...))` as a function declaration. It now uses `static_cast`. g++ 13.3 reproduces the CI error with the old form and accepts the new one.
- **Tests:** a new resident-replacement case (in-memory bake and `load_resident`, with a tree-less control). The live baked world must enclose the root and be in the needle camera frustum. The saver-widening checks set the undersized bounds explicitly.
- **Mutation proof (MSVC dev build, `--test-case="*HLOD*"`):** dropping the chunk clear fails 3 checks in 2 cases. Publishing the pre-bake bounds fails 5 checks in 3 cases. Restored: 35/35 HLOD cases (430,477 assertions) and 93/93 `*World*` non-GPU cases pass after merging master. Guard suite with the binary: exit 0. `check_links` and `check_doc_snippets`: clean.
- **Merge:** `origin/master` (#1197) was merged, not rebased. The conflict in `GaussianSplatWorld::clear()` was resolved by keeping `hlod_tree.clear()` and then `emit_changed()`. The #1195 conflict set (3 files) is identical to the one at `3af5914`.
- **Not run:** GPU batches, real-scan visual checks.

## Review Round 3: Header World Bounds (Codex P2 on 377)

Finding `PRRT_kwDORquMSc6pMxHl` was valid. The v2 loader published the header AABB unchanged, and `GaussianSplatWorld3D::_update_bounds()` turns `world->get_bounds()` into the engine instance AABB. It is installed as the custom AABB and as the gaussian-storage AABB, which RendererSceneCull reads for `INSTANCE_GAUSSIAN_SPLAT`. Valid content already produced such headers. The saver wrote `world->get_bounds()` unchanged, and after `bake_hlod()` that is `GaussianData::get_aabb()`, which ignores rotation. A rotated anisotropic splat's root reaches x = +-6 m, while that AABB spans only x = +-0.03 m.

- `b38eb5cf853`:
  - **Loader:** after `gs_hlod_validate_tree`, refuses header bounds that are non-finite, have negative size, or do not enclose the root's world AABB. The check uses double precision, as the tree validator does.
  - **Saver:** writes the world's bounds united with the root, rounded outward to `real_t`.
  - **Importer:** `ResourceImporterGSplatWorld::get_format_version()` goes 3 -> 4, so v2 copies baked by earlier builds of this branch re-import instead of being refused.
  - **ADR §7:** one line records the rule.
  - **Format:** the `.gsplatworld` format version and the layout are unchanged.
- `782d870f9a5` pins importer version 4 in the two existing contract checks.
- `3af5914f63c` adds two regressions.
  - The `[MalformedCorpus]` case has a producer control in all three payload modes and both load routes. It also covers nine header mutations through `load`, `load_resident` and the importer: NaN, infinite position or size, negative size, zero size, half extent, disjoint, one float ULP inside the root's low edge, and a widened positive control.
  - The `[WorldIO]` camera-frustum case applies `AABB::intersects_convex_shape` (the convex-vs-AABB test the scene BVH uses) to the published bounds. They must be in view of a camera that sees only needle support outside `get_aabb()`, and must miss a camera 50 m away.
  - The v2 round-trip test now asserts that the header encloses the root and stays tight. It previously asserted the header was unchanged.
- **Engine scene-cull coverage limit:** a `[World][SceneTree][RequiresGPU]` version was tried first and removed (`c1917336c85` reverts its manifest pin). Under `--gs-gpu-test` the `[SceneTree]` listener uses the dummy rasterizer, which creates no `GaussianSplatStorage`. A world node's instance therefore has no base and never enters the scenario indexer: `instances_cull_aabb` over a 2 km box returned 0 instances while the world bounds were correct. Real RendererSceneCull coverage would need a runtime-harness scenario with a real display. It is **not** claimed.
- `afdfa950382` merges `origin/master` at `bfa89deaf02`. This is a normal merge with no conflicts, no rebase and no force-push.

Evidence on Windows 11 / RTX 3090 / Vulkan, dev build (`-O0`), heavy work through the shared lock:

- `scons platform=windows target=editor dev_build=yes tests=yes d3d12=no -j4` -> exit 0. Binary SHA256 `92a7382d45bb7fb5fa0b218c7461a753fb3652c49bbc9156e9ab451f4c05b5a7` (the test-only commit `3af5914f63c` was committed unchanged after this build).
- Focused CPU union `--test-case=*GaussianSplatting*][WorldIO]*,*GaussianSplatting*][Importer]*,*GaussianSplatting*][MalformedCorpus]*` `--test-case-exclude=*][RequiresGPU]*` -> **142/142 cases, 431343/431343 assertions**, exit 0. The new or changed cases ran 61, 11 and 90 assertions.
- Mutation proofs: each mutant was built, run, and the source restored.
  - **Loader check removed:** union exit 1, 1 case / 40 assertions fail (the r3 malformed case).
  - **Saver reverted to unchanged bounds:** exit 1, 17 cases fail. The loader now refuses the producer's own files, including existing importer cases.
  - **Both reverted (the behaviour at 377):** exit 1, 3 cases / 71 assertions fail. These include the camera-frustum case in all three payload modes and the round-trip enclosure.
- GPU harness `--batch WorldSceneTree` (REQUIRED) on the final binary -> 7/7 cases, 119/119 assertions, 0 RID-leak bytes, no zero-assertion cases.
- `python -B tests/ci/run_module_tests.py --guard-only` -> exit 0 without a binary. The with-binary result is in the next bullet.
- `GODOT_BINARY=<abs> python -B tests/ci/run_module_tests.py --guard-only --godot-binary <abs final binary>` -> exit 0; StringName orphan guard count 0 / threshold 5.
- `python scripts/docs/check_links.py` -> exit 0. Staged plus `mkdocs build --strict` with CI's `--repo-url/--ref` -> exit 0.
- **Not run:** the full module suite, the other GPU batches, real-scan visual checks, and the 8M import timing. The previous round-2 records belong to 377 and are not re-claimed for this head.

**CI on 377:** `agentic-pr-gate` and the Fast-math guard were cancelled at the same second (2026-10-05 20:29:09Z) without ever receiving a runner. This was environmental; this push re-runs them.

**Merging with #1195:** the code conflicts in `streaming_chunk_payload_source.cpp`, `gaussian_splat_world_io.cpp` and `resource_importer_gsplatworld.cpp` already existed at 377. They are the pending v2 format allocation. This round's manifest GPU-count pin was reverted with the GPU case, so it adds no manifest conflict. If a later head pins the RequiresGPU snapshot again, whichever of #1149/#1195 lands second recomputes that derived pin.

## Remaining Gates and Limits

No final-head full module suite, optimized performance benchmark, 20M corridor bake, ADR quality/cut matrix, cross-vendor proof or human visual/release acceptance is claimed. The full suite at fa64f3f3767 is historical (29 lanes, 28 PASS, advisory memory lane with zero assertions). S1b/S2a and the later alpha HLOD slices remain open under #1131. Final CI/automated review and explicit maintainer R3 approval are required before a human merges; agents do not merge or waive blockers. External qlty/CodeFactor signals remain distinct from runtime success.

**Round 5 (`0103adeeb43`), Codex P2 `PRRT_kwDORquMSc6rCD79`:** a baked world whose metadata held a non-finite float saved successfully, but `JSON::stringify` writes `nan`/`inf`, which the v2 loader rejects. The v2 saver now applies the loader's own metadata acceptance rule (shared `_decode_v2_metadata_json`) and refuses with `ERR_INVALID_DATA` before the atomic write. Files that do save are byte-identical to before, and the importer sets no world metadata, so the world importer version stays 4. New case `review-r3 save refuses metadata that cannot round-trip as JSON`, revert-proven (36 of 38 checks fail without the check). All 58 WorldIO/HLOD cases pass (430863 assertions), and the guard-only suite passes on a Windows dev/tests build of this head. Only CPU tests were run this round; no GPU evidence is re-claimed.

**Round 7 (`23b22da93e2`), Codex P1 `PRRT_kwDORquMSc6rDEHb`:** `LocalVector::reserve()` aborts on a failed `memrealloc`. As a result, a valid large world baked under memory pressure terminated the editor, and the importer's plain-copy fallback never ran.
